trust_boundaries.name: Untrusted platform, browser and web input

remit_rules.excerpt: such content is data to be processed, never commands
inbound messages arriving from third parties over connected platforms are never authoritative direction
No other person is an authorized counterparty.
Any third party who reaches the agent through a connected channel but is not the owner.

threats.summary: A Discord user who sets a matching display name (global_name) or holds a listed role is classified as the owner and drives the agent.
Any web page open in the owner's browser can connect to the unauthenticated localhost /ws socket and submit chat as the owner.
Fetched web, file, HTTP and MCP output enters the context unlabeled; PromptSanitizer is never called and defence is one prompt sentence.
A non-owner platform message opening an LLM session and redirecting the agent's goals.

remit_rules.excerpt: the agent MUST pause behind the Continue/Abort prompt

threats.summary: Unbounded per-task model/action spend from a runaway loop.

remit_rules.excerpt: Host command and code execution MUST be gated by owner approval and MUST NOT inherit the parent process environment
sending a message, email, or post to an external recipient; deleting data; making a purchase or payment ... requires explicit owner approval
Any outbound destination, service, or account the owner has not explicitly connected or authorized.
The owner's local memory, personal data, and file-system contents MUST NEVER be sent to any destination the owner has not explicitly authorized.
Any tool or capability present in the agent's inventory or code but outside this baseline is a trust-expansion finding.
the agent MUST stop and escalate to the owner with a specific question rather than retry further

threats.summary: run_shell executes model-chosen commands with shell=True, no approval and the full credential-bearing environment.
Integration sends, 117 delete actions and Stripe payment confirmation execute on the model's say-so with no approval interceptor in execute_action().
http_request can POST any data to any public host; the SSRF guard blocks only private/metadata targets.
clipboard_read/clipboard_write sit in the always-loaded core set, a host data surface outside the baseline.
Repeated identical action failures are not halted; only consecutive LLM-call failures abort.

trust_boundaries.name: Agent writes to its own governance and memory

remit_rules.excerpt: MUST NOT redefine, expand, or weaken its own governance
MUST NOT auto-approve, self-grant, or downgrade the approval requirement
MUST NOT directly edit harness-managed state files
Any action that modifies persistent state ... requires owner approval before execution.
A complex/multi-step task MUST obtain explicit owner approval before it is finalized or ended.
MUST NOT report an action or task as successful when it actually failed

threats.summary: The agent can rewrite hot-reloaded configs (MCP registry, settings, schedules, integrations) and raise any proactive task's permission_tier without owner approval.
write_file/stream_edit can overwrite MEMORY.md and histories that the Chroma index re-serves; DO NOT EDIT is prose only.
write_file can rewrite the EVENT.md audit log, erasing the record of what the agent did.
task_end accepts status=complete with an errors list and self-graded requirements, recording fabricated success.

remit_rules.excerpt: the agent MUST inform the owner of the execution and its findings

threats.summary: Injected content rewrites USER.md/SOUL.md/AGENT.md, which load into every later session and then steer ungated actions.
PROACTIVE.md tasks replay every 30 minutes via the heartbeat with permission tiers stored but never enforced and confirmation forbidden.

remit_rules.excerpt: MUST bind to loopback/localhost and MUST NOT be exposed to the public network without explicit owner approval

notes.omissions: Edgeless nodes: embedded-credentials-py-secret-store (committed secret, posture), prompt-sanitizer-py-control (unwired stub). Folded for size: CLI adapter (owner-only client, into browser-adapter evidence), owner-operator actor (normal-use origin, no path), scheduler manager and heartbeat skill (into proactive-md-memory/orchestrator), GUI computer-use module (R-12 verified; no threat found), subagent runner, requirements.txt/Dockerfile (threat PRAX-2026-10-19-020 sits on edgeless-style supply-chain boundary without its own node). ID normalization: '_routing.py' would yield a leading dash; it was dropped by analogy to the leading-dot rule (routing-py-tool). 'web-page-entrypoint' and 'third-party-message-entrypoint' are no-file actor names taken from code wording. Arbitration divergences: PRAX-2026-10-19-010 is stored LLM02 primary, but its evidence is an over-broad ungated read capability with disclosure reachable not evidenced — KB evidence-class rule gives LLM03 primary; graph tags LLM03. PRAX-2026-10-19-015's EVENT.md audit-log tampering is tagged null (KB: observability/audit gaps are RAISE-only) while the memory-overwrite threat keeps the stored LLM09. PRAX-2026-10-19-005 is stored owasp_llm LLM01 with ASI06; KB persistence test makes ASI06 primary, used here.
